decisions.reason: The legacy claim has no machine-enforceable fitment or persisted product-identity evidence; the newly reviewed scoped 20-2403 candidate must replace it through a guarded merge.
The legacy WPGM-611V claim is unscoped and lacks persisted product-identity evidence; the newly reviewed 2008-2017 candidate is the safe replacement.
The current 82-1005AR claim has no door or side scope even though regulator assemblies are position-specific, so it can expose a wrong application.
FG0347 was confirmed only for 2000-2005 while the frozen issue spans earlier years; the unscoped public claim can therefore show outside proven fitment.
